verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents continuous background monitoring, automated evidence collection, alerting, and AI-driven workflow automation (e.g., continuous risk monitoring, AI Editor for ingestion workflows, automated evidence gap analysis) that run without manual triggering, plus a compliance-skills GitHub tool that fires PII/GDPR checks 'without being asked' during coding workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these automations truly run unattended over time, and more detail on scheduling/configuration controls for autonomy.
